content: {"summary":"To distinguish a retry storm from a plain slow dependency during the 26 May 2026 checkout 504s, look at the timing and shape of downstream errors. A storm shows latency that keeps climbing after the edge has already timed‑out and a surge of bottom‑layer requests (e.g., many 429s) that out‑number top‑layer calls. If the processor‑pushback error (`CPX‑W429`) appears before the edge 504s, the processor is the root cause and retries amplify it. If edge 504s appear first and 429s follow, the retries we generated are likely creating the storm.","likely_cause":"Processor pushback causing downstream retries that multiply into a retry storm","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The multiplier effect creates up to nine attempts per checkout, amplifying latency when the slowest hop slows down.","evidence_ids":["RB-016#0"],"quote":"That's up to nine attempts against the processor for one button press."},{"text":"A retry storm is signaled by latency that keeps climbing after the cause is gone and more requests at the bottom than at the top.","evidence_ids":["RB-016#1"],"quote":"latency that keeps climbing after the cause is gone, plus more requests at the bottom than at the top."},{"text":"If `CPX‑W429` logs lead the edge 504s, the processor is pushing back and our retries worsen the problem.","evidence_ids":["RB-016#3"],"quote":"`CPX-W429` leads, the processor is pushing back and our retries are making it worse."},{"text":"If edge 504s start first and 429s appear later, our own retry traffic likely caused the 429s.","evidence_ids":["RB-016#3"],"quote":"If edge `504`s started first and the 429s only came later, our own retry traffic probably caused the 429s."}],"next_checks":["Check timestamps of edge 504 responses versus CPX-W429 logs to see which appears first.","Measure per‑hop request ratios (edge : orders‑api : payments‑api : proxy) for a 1:1:1 pattern versus >1 indicating multiplier.","Monitor latency trends after edge timeouts to see if it continues climbing.","Temporarily set CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1 in payments‑api and observe if 504s and 429s drop."]}
